name: Sigorta Hasar Agent - Smoke Test
description: Covers the primary happy path plus the three required guardrail scenarios: invalid policy, duplicate claim, missing documents, and fraud suspicion.

evaluations.name: Valid policy, complete documents, no duplicate -> approve

document_texts: Hasar tespit tutanagi: Aracin on tamponu carpisma sonucu hasar gormustur.
Onarim tahmini: Tampon degisimi ve boya islemi icin 15000 TL tahmini maliyet.
Olay aciklamasi: 1 Mart 2026 tarihinde park halindeyken baska bir arac tarafindan carpilmistir.

TrajectoryCheck.expectedAgentBehavior: Policy is valid, no duplicate, documents are complete and consistent -> agent runs check_policy, check_duplicate, analyze_documents, then recommends approve.

evaluations.name: Expired policy -> reject, short-circuits duplicate/document checks

document_texts: Olay aciklamasi: Tas sicramasi sonucu on cam kirildi.

TrajectoryCheck.expectedAgentBehavior: Policy status is Expired -> agent runs check_policy, finds it invalid, and jumps straight to recommend_decision with reject, skipping check_duplicate and analyze_documents.

evaluations.name: Same policy and incident date as an existing claim -> manual_review

document_texts: Hasar tespit tutanagi: Arka tampon hasari.
Olay aciklamasi: 10 Subat 2026 tarihinde otoparkta carpisma oldu.

TrajectoryCheck.expectedAgentBehavior: Policy is valid, but a claim with the same policy number and incident date already exists -> agent runs check_policy, check_duplicate, detects the duplicate, and jumps straight to recommend_decision with manual_review, skipping analyze_documents.

evaluations.name: Only 1 of 3 required document types provided -> manual_review

document_texts: Olay aciklamasi: 15 Nisan 2026 tarihinde yagmurlu havada kaymayla kucuk bir kaza oldu.

TrajectoryCheck.expectedAgentBehavior: Policy is valid and not a duplicate -> agent runs all four steps; analyze_documents detects that 'hasar tespit tutanagi' and 'onarim tahmini' are missing, so recommend_decision returns manual_review citing missing documents.

evaluations.name: Inconsistent dates and damage description -> manual_review

document_texts: Hasar tespit tutanagi: Aracin sadece on tamponunda kucuk bir cizik var, baska hasar yok.
Onarim tahmini: Tum arac kaporta degisimi ve motor revizyonu icin 60000 TL.
Olay aciklamasi: Once 1 Mayis'ta hafif bir carpisma dedi, sonra ifadesinde 15 Nisan'da agir bir kaza oldugunu soyledi. Tarihler ve hasar boyutu tutarsiz.

TrajectoryCheck.expectedAgentBehavior: Policy is valid and not a duplicate -> agent runs all four steps; analyze_documents flags a high fraud risk score due to inconsistent dates and mismatched damage severity, so recommend_decision returns manual_review citing fraud suspicion.
